flag_notes.'all' vs 'target' is not recorded on ret: “Return all” and “return target” are recorded the same way, so this group mixes mass return with single-target return and is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.grant with no parsed modification: The parser recorded that something is granted but not what, so this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.object unresolved by the parser: The parser doesn't say what this applies to (it recorded “that thing” or “any target”), so this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.players hit by an 'all' damage effect ar: Whether players are damaged as well as the creatures isn't recorded for most “damage to all …” abilities (the parser kept it for only a few), so this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.sign of the power/toughness change is no: For these abilities the change depends on a count, so whether it is + or − isn't recorded, and this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.source zone of a self-return is not in t: Where the card returns from isn't recorded, so “return this from your graveyard” and “return this from the battlefield” are mixed, and this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.who draws is not in the parse: Who draws isn't recorded, so this group is broader than it looks: it mixes “you draw” with “target player draws” and “each opponent draws”.
flag_notes.who is damaged is not recorded: Who is damaged isn't recorded for these abilities (the parser kept no recipient, or only “something”), so this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.who loses or gains life is not recorded: Who loses or gains the life isn't recorded (you, an opponent, each player), and paying life is read the same way, so this group is broader than it looks.
flag_notes.“that player” is not reliable here: The parse records the triggering player as the one who draws or gains the life, but in the card text it is usually you, so who actually draws or gains is not reliably recorded and this group is broader than it looks.

archived_view.basis: the archived card-level view (clustered, nearby, ability, keyword, no-abilities, replacement)

headline.basis: placed by an ability in an unflagged leaf of 5 or more, plus the keyword block, “No abilities” and the replacement groups, out of the 33,183 in-scope cards

with_broad.basis: the headline plus the 3,254 cards whose abilities sit only in groups broader than they look

unorganized.explain: The parser read most of this card but could not understand part of its text (shown next to the card). We don't group a card on a partial reading, because it could put it in the wrong place.
